original_card.question: Can a specified pair of consecutive calls eliminate a restoration that the next call reconstructs?
methods: Write typed entry/exit contracts and a contracting multitype recurrence.
Derive a lower bound for the compulsory transitions of one proposed typed interface.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Show actual eliminated work and legal composition; changing a scalar recurrence into a matrix is insufficient.

first_step.inspect: Find a concrete consecutive-call boundary in the selected review and list its entry/exit obligations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Specify two call types and one operation actually removed by composition; derive the normalized recurrence.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Eliminating compulsory boundary work can lower recursive cost beyond packing gains.
allowed_variations: A two-type pilot or one explicit deferred restoration.
scope_change_triggers: Rewriting the old scalar recurrence as a matrix without eliminating work.

scope_change_reason: The broad interface question is refined to the same-source, same-family pair of two order-four five-child echoes already pinned in PR #1391; no heterogeneous call types or supplier change are considered.
actual_scope: For two identical five-child PR #1391 root echoes on the same source X, test a joint ten-child dirty echo that carries the order-four boundary phase across the midpoint; compare its fully priced word and exact map with two separate calls.
bottleneck_link: The original card targets compulsory boundary work; a joint call can carry one legal phase path across the midpoint and avoid the second independently compiled copy/restoration wrapper.
stop_rule: Stop after exact finite-state optimality for lengths 5 and 10, complete dirty-map and ADD/NEG/read/write/prefix invoices, or if the joint map fails or the favorable complete cost is not below two separate calls. Do not generalize beyond the pinned macro alphabet.
evidence: The README, standalone verifier, deterministic RESULT.json, and focused test record the recurrence, full dirty-map checks, exhaustive path coverage and complete invoices.
author: Cinna Davis
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in algebra, implementation, verification, and prose; no independent human review is claimed.

open_questions.question: Does a named selected supplier expose this exact paired order-four intertwiner?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Only a compatible precision-admitted supplier could transfer this gate saving to a selected recursive profile.
open_questions.first_step: Inspect one retained supplier exact child matrix for the paired-cycle invariant.
open_questions.blocked_by: No physical supplier with this interface has been admitted.

open_questions.question: Can the larger prefix row-L1 peak be absorbed by a selected fixed-precision profile?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The joint call raises the checked peak from 30 to 42, so primitive savings alone do not establish precision feasibility.
open_questions.first_step: Propagate the exact joint-word prefix coefficient envelope through a named host schedule.
open_questions.blocked_by: Supplier, address, tape, and fixed-precision admission are outside this experiment.
